description.en: A clever shortcut fills the bath—and keeps filling it. PinPin and his family put things right together.
description.ru: Пин-Пин придумал, как быстро наполнить ванну. Но вода всё льётся! Теперь вся семья помогает справиться с переполохом.
description.es: PinPin encuentra una forma rápida de llenar la bañera, ¡pero el agua no para! Toda la familia ayuda a arreglarlo.

alt.en: PinPin holds a little bucket beside the overflowing wooden bath; Mama supports PomPom and Papa holds a towel.
alt.ru: Пин-Пин с ведёрком у переполненной ванны; Мама держит Пом-Пома, а Папа — полотенце.
alt.es: PinPin sostiene un cubito junto a la bañera desbordada; Mamá lleva a PomPom y Papá tiene una toalla.

es: Un rayito de sol le hizo cosquillas en la nariz a PinPin. Desde la cocina llegaba el olor del desayuno.

style: Same warm dimensional animated-feature storybook art as approved family and bedtime references; soft expressive eyes with visible irises, tactile quills, warm timber and plaster. No photographic/PBR family faces.
magicRule: One fixed horizontal gold circle above shallow tub water, clockwise tracing creates a small continual fountain into tub. Same gesture counterclockwise erases ring and stops NEW water only. No extra streams at floor or self-moving buckets.
reviewRules: Same four hedgehogs, no duplicate siblings or human children.
PinPin solves reversal; Mama asks and watches, never reveals answer.
No Elder rescue, humiliation, chosen-one speech or moral lecture.
Maximum flooding shallow at paws; baby supported and dry with clear body separation.
One tub, two matched pails, one wooden duck; no bath/rug/furniture teleportation.
Specific action and partner eyeline each shot; reverse-circle camera matches creation camera.
Keep original generated masters and exact prompts. Generated is not user approved or published.
